title: Historic Medieval Harbour Oar Wood Old 02
description:
The ‘Historic Medieval’ themed assets capture the sturdy, timeworn feel of medieval stone and timber settings. Featuring high-fidelity scans of stone arches and doorways, fireplaces, wooden furniture and crates, scrolls, books, candle holders, and coiled rope, this collection reflects spaces built for daily life, work, and study.
Ideal for creating authentic period interiors and structures with a strong sense of scale, realism, and environmental storytelling.
